description: HIGH RISK: stops an existing BotSpot live deployment and changes a running trading system. Stopping the wrong bot can leave real-money exposure unmanaged. Only call this tool after the user has explicitly confirmed the stop action, broker mode, and target deployment in the current conversation. The tool always returns an approval URL for the signed-in user to authorize; it does not execute from chat-only approval or reusable grants. For Codex, Claude, Cursor, and other clients without BotSpot native confirmation cards, return the exact authorizationUrl as a clickable Markdown link in your reply. Do not say a card or button was created unless the client actually rendered it. BotSpot clients may render structuredContent as a native confirmation, but a button name alone is not an approval link. A pending request is not execution; only the signed-in user may approve on the website. Report expiry and check get_deployment_action_status after approval.
name: stop_deployment
title: Stop a live deployment
